new_problem: Finite-source H1 ground CI in the dynamic thermal/UV/Compton/H1n2 model with an explicit common hydrogen electronic energy registry; retain21 populations,78full/75active at ellmax8.
hypotheses: CI transfers thermal energy to ionization binding while increasing particle count and changes the subsequent ionization/Thomson history.
Sharing fresh fields within one RHS and redundant source-moment terms reduces cost without changing per-entry accumulation order or solver tolerances.
